accountable_decision_owner: Cole Lyons, USHSO Public Alpha methodology owner
active_family_basis: No approved source enumerates current eligible essential-service designations under one issuer taxonomy, effective-period rule, facility-to-system crosswalk, and duplicate rule; providerType aggregation, combination-code expansion or deduplication, stale roster rollup, state/federal mixing, narrative substitution, missing-as-zero, imputation, and fabricated zeroes are prohibited.
active_family_definition: Count of current eligible essential-service designations under one approved issuer taxonomy and duplicate rule, within one approved product-system boundary and common effective period.
comparison_period_rule: No common effective period or lag window is approved; AHRQ 2023 identity and hospital linkage cannot be combined with CMS April 2026 provider records and code definitions into product-system designation counts.
comparison_purpose: Determine whether essential_service_designation_count can be appended to the common nine-input Scale v1 packet without weakening the frozen roster, period, designation taxonomy, issuer, eligible-code, effective-record, facility-crosswalk, combination-code, deduplication, or organizational-boundary gates.
